card.name: Start of words like trace and tracing
card.fires_on: The opening piece "tr" or "Tr" (also "R" in MULTITRACE) when the word is split and the next piece is likely "ace", as in traced, tracings, Tracing. Also fires on similar splits in brand names such as Trisogel and CONTRACEPTIVES.

modes.label: Trace and tracing words
modes.description: The split start of traced, tracings or Tracing, where "ace" is expected next.
modes.example: By October twenty-third there were About 150 cases of which most could be <<tr>>aced to the North Dakota region.

modes.label: Brand and drug names
modes.description: The split start of product names or terms that contain "trace" or a similar sound.
modes.example: Aseptic addition of MULTIT<<R>>ACE ® - 5 to parenteral

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the word trace, as in trace, traces, traced and tracing.
card.plain: It notices a word that has just begun with "tr" and is probably going to be "trace" or "tracing".
